statement: Meta laid off about 8,000 employees.
The cuts are roughly 10% of Meta's workforce.
Meta had just under 80,000 employees at the end of March 2026.
About 7,000 more workers were moved to new AI-focused teams.
New AI teams named: Applied AI Engineering, Agent Transformation Accelerator XFN, Central Analytics.
Singapore workers were notified first (around 4 a.m. local time).
Cuts hit integrity, cybersecurity, and Reality Labs; AI infrastructure and monetization teams were protected.
note: used only as background, softened in text

statement: Chief People Officer Janelle Gale announced the reassignments.
At a July 2, 2026 town hall, Zuckerberg said AI agent progress over the prior ~4 months "hasn't really accelerated in the way that we expected."
Zuckerberg said he expects benefits within three to six months.

statement: Meta's projected 2026 capital spending is about $125-145 billion, more than double 2025.

statement: Norway beat Brazil 2-1 in the Round of 16.
The match was played on July 5, 2026.
Venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey.
Erling Haaland scored both Norway goals, in the 79th and 90th minutes.
note: single source (score corroborated by Al Jazeera)

statement: Neymar scored a late penalty for Brazil (added time, as a substitute).
It was Norway's first-ever World Cup quarterfinal.
Norway had not played at a World Cup for 28 years before this tournament.
Goalkeeper Ørjan Nyland saved a Bruno Guimarães penalty in the 14th minute.
Brazil were five-time World Cup winners entering the round.
Neymar, aged 34, announced the end of his international career after the match.
Neymar quote: "I tried. It started here, at MetLife Stadium, and I finished here. It is now over."
Neymar is Brazil's all-time top scorer; his international debut was August 10, 2010, also at MetLife Stadium.
